notes: Topology is separated from asset capacity and hydrological constraints so each can be audited independently.
Routes describe the main energy-producing water paths. Spill/bypass arcs are represented separately where they bypass generation.
Daily dispatch will still use HMD tributary inflows, storage, spill and consent constraints; this file defines connectivity, not operating policy.

Waikato river.dispatch_note: Lake Taupo releases and tributary additions propagate through the Waikato cascade, subject to small intermediate storages, local inflows, spill and consent constraints.

Waikaremoana.dispatch_note: First-order energy path follows Lake Waikaremoana through Kaitawa, Tuai and Piripaua; detailed siphon/spill and stage-dependent rules remain in HMD constraints.

generation_paths.name: Tekapo_to_Pukaki
generation_paths.note: Tekapo A and Gate 17 feed the Tekapo-Pukaki canal; Tekapo B discharges the combined canal flow into Lake Pukaki. Gate 17 can bypass Tekapo A but is already upstream of Tekapo B.

generation_paths.name: Pukaki_to_Ruataniwha
generation_paths.note: The Pukaki canal feeds Ohau A, whose tailrace enters Lake Ruataniwha. Lake Ohau water is not treated as an input to Ohau A.

generation_paths.name: Lake_Ohau_to_Ruataniwha
generation_paths.note: Lake Ohau contributes independently to Lake Ruataniwha via the Upper Ohau River/canal system; HMD natural Ohau inflow is defined for the Ohau B/C portion of the scheme rather than as an Ohau A input.

generation_paths.name: Ruataniwha_to_Benmore
generation_paths.note: Water from Lake Ruataniwha passes through Ohau B and then Ohau C before entering Lake Benmore.

Waitaki river.dispatch_note: Upper Waitaki is branched. Pukaki water generates first at Ohau A before entering Ruataniwha; Lake Ohau contributes separately to Ruataniwha; Ohau B/C then share the combined Ruataniwha outflow. Direct river/spill releases sacrifice different sets of stations and must retain distinct route values.

Clutha.dispatch_note: Hāwea regulation, Lake Wānaka outflow and Lake Wakatipu/Kawarau flows merge upstream of Lake Dunstan/Clyde; Clyde discharge continues to Roxburgh.

generation_paths.name: Te_Anau_to_Manapouri_generation
generation_paths.note: Te Anau releases flow down the Upper Waiau into Lake Manapouri; Manapouri generation discharges through the tailrace to Deep Cove rather than continuing down a hydro cascade.

Manapouri.dispatch_note: Lower Waiau releases from Manapouri are non-generating bypass outflows for this energy topology and remain governed by operating guidelines/constraints.
